newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-PSV BEAT RKC 4-1 TO RESTORE THREE-POINT LEAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSV BEAT RKC 4-1 TO RESTORE THREE-POINT LEAD.

text.p: PSV Eindhoven restored their three-point lead over Feyenoord in the Dutch first division when they beat RKC Waalwijk 4-1 away on Sunday.
PSV lead the league with 54 points from 23 matches, Feyenoord have 51 and Twente Enschede are third with 49 points.
Champions Ajax Amsterdam, whose away match against Sparta Rotterdam was postponed because of fears of crowd trouble, are fifth with 36 points from 22 matches.
In an incident-packed match PSV took an early lead when defender Jaap Stam headed home a Wim Jonk free kick in the 10th minute.
After half an hour Marciano Vink stole past RKC's offside trap and beat goalkeeper Rob van Dijk to make the score 2-0.
Five minutes later Brazilian striker Marcelo made it 3-0 when he stroked a Boudewijn Zenden cross into the net.

In the 38th minute Delano Hill grabbed one back for the home side when he headed home a corner but a minute before time Stam claimed his second goal of the night, this time from a Jonk corner. It was Stam's sixth goal of the season.
PSV now have a week to prepare for next Sunday's decisive top-of-the-table clash at Feyenoord.
The Rotterdammers won 2-0 at home on Saturday against bottom-placed NEC Nijmegen thanks to two goals by striker Pablo Sanchez in a lacklustre match.
Twente kept in touch with the two leading teams by beating Vitesse Arnhem 1-0 on Sunday.
